name: Grey Lady
description: 'Grey Lady' is a recurring archetype in British, North American, and broader anglophone ghost-lore: a female apparition dressed in grey, usually associated with a specific historic building and a tragic backstory.
regions: New England and the Midwest US
origin: Anglophone world, with concentrations in the British Isles and North America. The Wikipedia disambiguation page lists Grey Lady ghosts in England, Northern Ireland, Malta, New Zealand, and the United States.
